capability_declaration.evidence: IEC 61850-7-3, 7-4 (Logical Nodes, Common Data Classes), IEC 61850-7-1 §10.2 (Modelling concepts), IEC 61850-8-1 (ACSI services: GetLogicalNodeDirectory, GetDataDirectory, GetDataSetDirectory)
capability_declaration.rationale: Logical Nodes and Data Objects explicitly model device functions, but are static (SCL-configured), lacking dynamic 'soft' capability negotiation typical of agentic AI systems.

bounded_authority.evidence: IEC 61850-7-4 §5.6 (Modelling of control: select-before-operate, interlocking CILO LN), IEC 61850-8-1 §17 (Control model: enhanced security via station-wide interlocking)
bounded_authority.rationale: Control models (SBO, interlocking) imply operational limits, but no clauses define explicit agent authority scope, ceilings, revocation, or expiry.

decision_auditability.evidence: IEC 61850-7-2 §12.4 (Logging: LCB, LOG LN), IEC 61850-7-4 §5.14 (Generic log LN: GEN_LOG)
decision_auditability.rationale: Logging services exist for events and data changes, but are generic; no standardised format for attributing agent decisions or recording AI inference logic.

data_governance.rationale: IEC 61850 does not address data ownership, user consent, retention policies, or privacy; these are out of scope for this communication standard.
